judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria: it wraps non-Error rejections in an Error with `cause` set to the original value, preserves the original rejection at the caller boundary, updates the spec and CHANGELOG, and keeps existing tests untouched. However, there is a small edge case in `new Error(String(error), {cause: error})` where an object with a null prototype (`Object.create(null)`) or `Symbol()` will cause `String(error)` to throw a `TypeError`, unlike the reference which attempts `JSON.stringify` first; additionally, in the plain-object acceptance test, the candidate forgot to explicitly assert `seenError?.cause === reason` (though `String(error)` and `{cause: error}` in the production code does set it). The candidate also left behind its `.lore/dod.md` scratch file and created a separate `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than consolidating the parametrized test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did.
